raw_response:
properties:
  bucketName:
    type: string
    description: The name of the Cloud Storage bucket the function needs to read from.
  serviceAccountName:

    description: The short name for the service account (e.g., 'my-function-sa').
    default: function-reader-sa
  serviceAccountDisplayName:

    projectId: {{ env['project'] }}

  type: g
